भंगः [भंज् --भावादौ घञ्]
1
Breaking, breaking down, shattering,
tearing down, splitting, dividing;
वार्यर्गलाभंग इव प्रवृत्तः

.
--2 A
break, fracture, breach.
--3
Plucking off, lopping; आम्रक्रलिकाभंग
Ś. 6.
--4 Separation, analysis.
--5 A
portion, bit, fragment, detached
portion; पुष्पोच्चयः पल्लवभंगभिन्नः

.
--6 Fall,
downfall, decay, destruction, ruin; as in
राज्य˚, सत्त्व˚ &c.
--7 Breaking up,
dispersion; यात्राभंग

.
--11
A chasm, fissure.
--12 Interruption,
obstacle, disturbance; निद्रा˚, गति˚
&c.
--13 Non-performance,
suspension, stoppage.
--14 Taking to
flight, flight.
--15 (a) A bend,
fold. (b) A wave.
--16
Contraction, bending, knitting;
ग्रीवाभंगाभिरामं Ś. 1. 7; so भ्रूभंग

.
--17 Going, motion.
--18 Paralysis.
--19 Fraud, deceit.
--20 A canal,
water-course.
--21 A circumlocutory
or round-about way of speaking or
acting; see भंगि.
--22 Hemp.
--Comp.
--नयः removal of obstacles.
--वासा
turmeric.
--नार्थ a. disho nest,
fraudulent.

1 Hemp.
--2 An intoxicating
drink prepared from hemp.
--Comp.
--कटं the pollen of hemp.

भांग a. (गी f.) [भंगाया इदं अण्]
Made of hemp, hempen.

भंगिः --गी f.
1 Breaking,
fracture, breach, division.
--2
Undulation.
--3 Bending,
contracting; दृग्भंगीभिः प्रथममथुरा संगमे
चुंबितोऽस्मि Ud.

.
--4 A wave.
--5
A flood, current.
--6 A crooked path,
tortuous or winding course.
--7 A
circumlocutory or round-about way
of speaking or acting, periphrasis;
भंग्यंतरेण कथनात् K.

व्यज्यते-कथ्यते &c.;
बहुभंगिविशारदः Dk.
--8 A pretext, disguise,
semblance; यः पांचजन्यपतिबिंबभंग्या
धारांभसः फेनमिव व्यनक्ति

.
--9 Trick, fraud, deceit.
--10 Irony.
--11 Repartee, wit.
--12 A step;

.
--13 An interval.
--14
Modesty.
--Comp.
--भक्तिः f. division
into a series of waves or wave-like
steps, a wavy staircase;

भंगिः --गी f.
1 Breaking,
fracture, breach, division.
--2
Undulation.
--3 Bending,
contracting; दृग्भंगीभिः प्रथममथुरा संगमे
चुंबितोऽस्मि Ud.

.
--4 A wave.
--5
A flood, current.
--6 A crooked path,
tortuous or winding course.
--7 A
circumlocutory or round-about way
of speaking or acting, periphrasis;
भंग्यंतरेण कथनात् K.

व्यज्यते-कथ्यते &c.;
बहुभंगिविशारदः Dk.
--8 A pretext, disguise,
semblance; यः पांचजन्यपतिबिंबभंग्या
धारांभसः फेनमिव व्यनक्ति

.
--9 Trick, fraud, deceit.
--10 Irony.
--11 Repartee, wit.
--12 A step;

.
--13 An interval.
--14
Modesty.
--Comp.
--भक्तिः f. division
into a series of waves or wave-like
steps, a wavy staircase;

भंगिन् a.
1 Frail, fragile,
transient; तदपि तत्क्षणभांगि करोति चेत्

भंगिमन् m.
1 Fracture, breach.
--2
Bending, undulation.
--3 Curliness.
--4 Disguise, deceit.
--5 Wit, irony.
--6 Perversity.

भंगिलं A defect in the organs of
sense.

भंगुर a. [भंज्-घुरच्]
1 Apt to
break, fragile, brittle.
--2 Frail,
transitory, transient, perishable;
आमरणांताः प्रणयाः कोपास्तत्क्षणभंगुराः
[]

; Śi. 16. 72.
--3
Changeful, variable.
--4 Crooked, bent.
--5
Curved, curled; शशिमुखि तव भाति
भंगुरभ्रूः

.
--6 Fraudulent,
dishonest, crafty.
--रः The bend of
a river.
--Comp.
--निश्चय a.
vacillating, unsettled in mind.

To break to
pieces, destroy.
--2 To curl.

भंज् {vI.v} {c7c} P. (भनक्ति, बभंज,
अभांक्षीत्, भंक्ष्यति, भंक्तुं, भग्न; desid. बिभंक्षति)
1 To break, tear down, shatter,
shiver or break to pieces, split;
भनज्मि सर्वमर्यादाः

.
--2 To
devastate, destroy by pulling down;
भनक्त्युपवनं कपिः

.
--3 To
make a breach (in a fortress).
--4 To
frustrate, foil, disappoint, baffle;
पिनाकिना भग्नमनोरथा सती

.
--5 To arrest, check, interrupt,
suspend; as in भग्ननिद्रः.
--6 To defeat,
vanquish; क्षत्राणि रामः परिभूय
रामात्क्षत्राद्यथाऽभज्यत स द्विजेंद्रः

.
--प्र {1} to break down,
shatter, splinter. {2} to stop, arrest,
suspend. {3} to frustrate,
disappoint. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (भंजयति-ते)
1 To
brighten, illuminate.
--2 To speak.
--3 To shine.

भंजन a. (नी f.) [भंज् ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
1 Breaking, splitting.
--2 Arresting,
checking.
--3 Frustrating.
--4
Causing violent pain.
--नं
1 Breaking
down, shattering, destroying.
--2
Removing, dispelling, driving
away; तदुदितभयभंजनाय यूनां

.
--3 Routing, vanquishing.
--4
Frustrating.
--5 Checking, interrupting,
disturbing.
--6 Afflicting, paining
--नः Decay of the teeth.

भंजनकः A particular disease of the
mouth which consists in the decay
of the teeth attended with
contortion of the lips.

भंजरुः A tree growing near a
temple.

भंड् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (भंडते)
1 To chide,
upbraid.
--2 To mock, deride.
--3
To speak.
--4 To jest, joke. {vII.v}
{c10c} U. (भंडयति-ते)
1 To make
fortunate.
--2 To cheat (properly भंट्).
--3 To be fortunate.
--4 To do an
auspicious act.

भंडः [भंड्-अच्]
1 A buffoon,
jester, mime; त्रयो वेदस्य कर्तारो
भंडधूर्तपिशाचकाः Sarva. S.
--2 N. of a
mixed caste; cf. भड.
--Comp.
--तपस्विन् m. a pseudo ascetic.
--हासिनी
a harlot, courtezan.

भांडकः --कं A small vessel, cup.
--कं Goods, merchandise, wares.

भंडनं [भंड्-ल्युट्]
1 Mail, armour.
--2 War, battle.
--3 Mischief,
wickedness.

भांडिः f. A razor-case.
--Comp.
--वाहः a barber.
--शाला a barber's
shop.

भंडिल a. Happy, auspicious,
prosperous, fortunate.
--लः
1 Good
fortune, happiness, welfare.
--2 A
messenger.
--3 A workman, artisan.
--4
The Śirīṣa tree.

भन् {c1c} P. (भनति)
1 To worship.
--2 To cry, shout, resound.

भंद् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (भंदते)
1 To tell a
good news.
--2 To be glad.
--3 To
be fortunate.
--4 To be excellent.
--5
To honor, worship.
--6 To shine.
{vII.v} {c10c} U. (भंदयति-ते)
1 To do an
auspicious act.
--2 To cause to thrive.

1 Prosperity, good fortune.
--2 Tremulous motion.
--3 A
messenger (m. ?)

भंभरालिका, भंभराली
1 A
gadfly.
--2 A gnat.

भंभरालिका, भंभराली
1 A
gadfly.
--2 A gnat.
भंभारवः The lowing of a cow.

भांगीनं [भंगाया भवनं क्षेत्रं घञ्] A
field of hemp.

भांगकः A tattered cloth, shred,
rag.

भांडं [भांड्-अच् भण्-ड स्वार्थे अण् वा
Tv.]
1 A vessel, pot, utensil (plate,
dish, can &c.); नीलीभांडं ‘an
indigovat’; so क्षीरभांडं ‘a milk-pail’;
सुरा˚, मद्य˚ &c.
--2 A box, trunk,
chest, case; क्षुरभांडं

.
--3 Any
tool or instrument, an implement.
--4 A musical instrument.
--5 Goods,
wares, merchandise, shop-keeper's
stock; मथुरागामीनि भांडानि

.
--6
A bale of goods.
--7 (Fig.) Any
valued possession, treasure; शांतं वा
रघुनंदने तदुभयं तत्पुत्रभांडं हि मे

.
--8 The bed of a river.
--9
Trappings or harness of a horse.
--10 Buffoonery, mimicry (from भडं).
--11 An ornament in general.
--डाः
(m. pl.) Wares, merchandise.
--Comp.
--अ (आ) गारः, --रं {1} a
store-house, store-room (lit. where
household goods and utensils &c.
are kept); भांडागाराण्यकृत विदुषां सा
स्वयं भोगभांजि

. {2}
treasury ज्ञाम˚. {3} a collection, store,
magazine.
--आगरिकः {1} a
storekeeper. {2} a treasurer.
--पतिः
a merchant.
--पुटः a barber.
--पुष्पः
a sort of snake.
--प्रतिभांडकं barter,
computation of the exchange of
goods.
--भरकः the contents of a
vessel.
--मूल्यं capital in the form
of wares.
--वादनं playing on a
musical instrument.
--शाला a store-house,
store.

भांडकः --कं A small vessel, cup.
--कं Goods, merchandise, wares.

भांडारिन् m. The keeper of a
storehouse.

भांडिका^1 An implement, a tool,
utensil.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

भानं [भा-भावे ल्युट्]
1 Appearing,
being visible.
--2 Light, lustre.
--3
Perception, knowledge.

]
1
Light, lustre, brightness.
--2 A ray
of light; मंडिताखिलदिक्प्रांताश्चंडांशोः
पांतु भानवः

.
--3 The sun; भानुः
सकृद्युक्ततुरंग एव Ś. 5. 4; भीमभानौ
निदाघे

.
--4 Beauty.
--5 A day.
--6 A king, prince, sovereign.
--7 An
epithet of Śiva. --f. A handsome
woman.
--Comp.
--केश (स) रः the
sun.
--जः the planet Saturn.
--दिनं,
--वारः Sunday.

भानुमत् a.
1 Luminous, bright,
splendid.
--2 Beautiful, handsome.
--m. The sun;

.
--ती N. of the wife
of Duryodhana.
